evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/clm-s731/<planId>/ with gate runs under tmp/clm-s731/<planId>/final/. Before repeating a gate run, move final/ to attempt-<n>/. Retry loops write <name>-1.log..<name>-3.log and copy the green attempt to <name>.log. tmp/ holds only .log, .txt, .json and .jsonl data, never binaries or .ts files. Cargo output goes to target/ (artifactRoots ["target"] in every plan); target/clm-baseline/nodetto-cli is the pre-change baseline binary and must never be deleted (no cargo clean).

Fixes 1-3 with tests: TB title band at the top, precomputed frame ranks, documentRelativePath with ../ and symlink traversal tests.

intentionalTradeoffs: Dirty-page scoping for A7 instead of a Rust host change: per-op work bounded by the edited page, guarded by byte-identical expected outputs.
A single wiring plan (clm-09) owns all shared registration files, so feature modules import new core symbols by relative path until wiring lands.
BPMN layered applies container commands then unit commands (two applies) instead of depending on keepMembers.
The BPMN flow label box uses estimated text metrics.
If the A7 1.5x CPU target is not reached after profiling, clm-02 records it as unmet instead of marking itself done.
supportedEdgeCases: Multi-page documents where an unrelated page holds 600 nodes and 300 obstacle-avoiding connectors (multiPage and mixedMultiPage fixtures).

carryMembers:false on move and resize for frames, pools, lanes (height only), sub-processes and boards; group and non-container targets are rejected with fixed errors; BPMN lane and pool invariants are checked.

name: references with zero or several matches are rejected with a list of candidates (id, type, text); where with an expect mismatch aborts the batch without writing; where with no expect and zero matches is an error; select binds an @ref.
Arrange-layered TB mode reserves the frame title band at the top.
lint-diagram image paths with ../ or symlink traversal are normalized and reported; containment stays at readAttachment.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Layered and route arrange for sequence, breadboard and pcb pages (excluded, with the reasons documented in clm-09 help).
MCP schema changes (nodetto_edit takes free-form args).
Changing existing defaults (frame carry, tidy, overlaps, edit --arrange, BPMN label rendering without labelPosition).
Rust or native host changes unless clm-02 profiling proves a host cost (that would need an amendment).
Server, auth or deployment code; pushes, tags, releases.
residualRisks: Dirty-page scoping depends on a complete cross-page dependency audit; byte-identical expected files guard it.
Native deadline tests may fail under load after 3 attempts; deadlines are never relaxed.
